about_the_game:
Slip off the flip‑flops and crank the volume—“Sex on the Beach (Latin Pop, Rock, Tropical, Soft Adult, Contemporary)” is here to turn your living room into a moon‑lit shoreline.

(Inner monologue: “Remember to hydrate. Passion is a cardio workout.”)

Why You’ll Love It

Latin‑infused grooves & silky soft‑rock riffs—perfect for swaying hips or pretending you can dance (we don’t judge).

Tropical percussion that sounds like it was smuggled inside a beach bag full of forbidden maracas.

Velvety vocals brimming with summery temptation and just enough flirtation to make your cheeks match the sunset.

Contemporary, layered production—from lush guitars to bass lines smoother than a piña colada on payday.

Built‑in ocean breeze ambience. We considered shipping actual sand. Legal said no.

Perfect For

Background bliss during late-night dev sprints—because bugs feel friendlier when bongos are involved.

Steam Deck lounging, balcony cocktails, or in‑game beach scenes that need a little more... sweat.

Those “I deserve this” self‑care moments: candlelight, headphones, and maybe a tiny umbrella in your drink.

Track List

1_Sex on the Beach (Latin Pop, Soft Adult, Contemporary) Var.1 – 03:04

2_Sex on the Beach (Latin Pop, Soft Adult, Contemporary) Var.2 – 03:11

3_Sex on the Beach (Latin Pop, Rock, Tropical) Var.1 – 02:50

4_Sex on the Beach (Latin Pop, Rock, Tropical) Var.2 – 02:51

Inner monologue: “This is technically four mini‑vacations. All-inclusive. No passport needed.”

System Requirements

Just ears, taste, and ideally... a fan. This soundtrack runs hot.

content_descriptors.notes: The lyrics include the phrase "Sex on the beach", which, while a popular cultural expression, still carries a sexual undertone in the context of the song (e.g., "Touch me close," "passion," "hands that tease").

name: Sex on the beach (Latin Pop, Rock, Tropical, Soft Adult, Contemporary)
short_description: A steamy blend of Latin pop, soft rock, and tropical vibes—"Sex on the Beach" brings sun-kissed rhythms, sultry vocals, and beachside passion straight to your headphones. Perfect for summer nights, chill sessions, or soundtrack-worthy seduction.
